channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: From a puppy printed logo to half of the UK market share: How Muddy Fox brought mountain biking to the British masses
item.description: While the evolution of American mountain biking is etched in Californian dust and myth, at just about the same time, in the mud of old Blighty, a whole home-brewed Brit MTB scene was also rising fast. This is the tale of Muddy Fox

item.title: “An absolute sense of loss”: Winning bike stolen from world champion duathlete
item.description: The duathlete described the break-in as “invasive”, saying it left her feeling unsafe in her own home and disrupted her preparation for the World Championships

item.title: £1.5m cycle route plan scrapped after two years
item.description: Plans to improve a narrow shared-use path along the A39 have been cancelled due to “logistical challenges”

item.title: "They are wrong": Mayor denounces council cycle lane plan as a return to "chaos"; Councillor baffled that cyclocross used "the green areas" of park; Olympic champion Kenny backs new velodrome proposal in West Midlands + more on the live blog
item.description: Callum is here, happy, healthy and alive, and scrambling to plan his last Christmas presents. In the meantime, the blog must go on...

item.title: Mous UltraTex Optimal Lid Backpack
item.description: Business-class carry-on luggage with a pocket for everything – albeit at business-class pricing 8/10

item.title: Council demands “urgent action” from Lime and Forest hire bike operators to “fix persistent problems”
item.description: Islington Council leader threatens to “remove access” to spaces unless issues with dangerous parking and poor rider behaviour are addressed

item.title: Why don’t cyclists use the bike path? Because it fell in the river: Historic cycling and walking bridge collapses as councillors say it will be “nigh on impossible” to fix
item.description: Spey Viaduct, part of the National Cycle Network, collapsed after river flow appears to have eroded bridge piers, forcing cyclists onto a nine-mile detour

item.title: Shimano launches new GRX RX717 components to bring electronic shifting on gravel bikes down to a (slightly) friendlier price point
item.description: Shimano's new Di2 gravel offering brings better affordability for gravel riders and commuters looking to move to electronic shifting. That said, the new RX717 rear derailleur will save you just £50 vs the RX827 version

item.title: Vielo V+1 Race Edition SRAM FORCE XPLR AXS gravel bike
item.description: Race bike performance with the versatility of an adventure machine 9/10

item.title: Active travel progress "slows" in Wales, as campaigners warn "less effective" cycling infrastructure possible under new funding changes
item.description: The Active Travel in Wales Annual Report shows more adults are cycling but raises concerns over the end of ringfenced funding and reveals that none of last year’s recommendations have been fully achieved
